technical_and_design_decisions: Use Maven/Gradle as the build system, consistent with existing project setup.
Assume admin-ui uses a modern JavaScript framework (e.g., Angular) and flo is a diagramming tool; both will be styled using shared CSS variables.
Shell commands for scaling will be implemented using Spring Shell, invoking existing REST APIs for module instance management.
Version and SPI type will be added as static text in an about page component, reading from build properties.
Screenshots for batch DSL documentation will be captured manually or via automated tool and embedded in AsciiDoc/Markdown.
The design review (U7) is a non-coding activity that produces a document of limitations and gaps.
assumptions: The existing codebase is well-structured and the developer has full understanding of it.
Lattice version 0.6.0 is backward-compatible with the current API usage, requiring only version bump and minor adjustments.
Renaming references (Spring XD -> Spring Cloud Data Flow, Job -> Task) can be partially automated with IDE refactoring tools.
No major architectural changes are required; user stories are independent and can be implemented sequentially.
All user stories will be fully unit tested and integrated, with regression testing performed at the end.
The design review (U7) does not generate code changes; its findings may be addressed in future increments.

activities.activity_description: Update build configuration (pom.xml/build.gradle) to use Lattice 0.6.0, check for API changes, adjust code if needed, and run unit tests to verify compatibility.

activities.activity_name: Replace Spring XD references with Spring Cloud Data Flow
activities.activity_description: Search and replace all occurrences of 'Spring XD' in source code, configuration files, documentation, and UI text with 'Spring Cloud Data Flow', ensuring correct capitalization and context.

Rename all class names, method names, variable names, comments, and configuration keys from 'Job'/'Jobs' to 'Task'/'Tasks' (including plural forms), update database schema references if any, and adjust related tests.

activities.activity_name: Implement consistent look and feel for admin-ui and flo
activities.activity_description: Review current UI styles for admin-ui and flo, define a shared design system (colors, fonts, spacing), update CSS/SCSS files, and apply changes to ensure visual consistency across both interfaces.

activities.activity_name: Add version and SPI type to about section
activities.activity_description: Modify the admin-ui about page to display the current application version (from build properties) and the SPI type (e.g., 'local', 'cloud') by reading configuration or injecting a bean.

activities.activity_name: Capture Flo Graphs as screenshots for batch DSL documentation
activities.activity_description: Run the application to create sample batch DSL graphs in Flo, take screenshots of the graphs, and embed them in the relevant documentation pages (e.g., AsciiDoc) with descriptive captions.

activities.activity_name: Revisit existing design and identify limitations/gaps
activities.activity_description: Conduct a thorough review of the current codebase architecture, component interactions, and known issues; produce a document listing limitations, gaps, and potential improvements (no code changes in this activity).

activities.activity_name: Implement direct shell commands to scale up/down module instances
activities.activity_description: Create two new Spring Shell commands (scale-up, scale-down) that accept a module instance identifier and target count, invoke the appropriate REST API endpoints, and handle success/failure responses.
Run full test suite, fix any integration issues arising from combined changes, perform manual exploratory testing on UI and shell commands, and ensure all user stories are verified.
Update overall project documentation to reflect changes (new features, renamed references, screenshots), prepare release notes, and verify build/packaging is consistent.
